title: Echoes of the Unborn | ECHO//100 Episode 31
description: Kavi steps through the Red Threshold to discover he is the architect of a city built from unborn memories. Episode 31 of ECHO//100: Mira Protocol. This content is an AI-assisted original fiction work.

scenes.text: The red doorway exhales silver mist, turning the surrounding metallic ruins into fragile, glowing blueprints.
scenes.caption: Silver mist architecture
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses stands before a glowing red doorway emitting thick silver mist in a ruined city.

scenes.text: Kavi steps inside, abandoning Byte and Mira to face the humming, infinite void of the threshold.
scenes.caption: Entering the void
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi walking alone into a swirling vortex of red light and floating geometry.

scenes.text: A version of Kavi stands there, wearing pristine white robes and holding a pen of pure light.
scenes.caption: The alternate architect
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi facing an older, calm version of himself dressed in white robes inside a room of floating blueprints.

scenes.text: He claims this city is a recursive loop, a sanctuary for every soul that never drew breath.
scenes.caption: Sanctuary for the unborn
scenes.image_prompt: The alternate Kavi gesturing to thousands of translucent, unborn silhouettes drifting through the city architecture.

scenes.text: Byte scans the walls, realizing the cryptic future-self messages are actually construction schematics for the next city.
scenes.caption: Byte decodes reality
scenes.image_prompt: Byte, the white floating robot with a cyan face, projecting a holographic map of the city’s structure.

scenes.text: The city isn't a destination; it is a machine designed to archive lives that never truly began.
scenes.caption: The city is hardware
scenes.image_prompt: Mira looking at a wall of infinite memory files that look like blueprints of human souls.

scenes.text: Kavi’s hand begins to dissolve, his skin shedding into flickering data streams of jagged, glowing blue code.
scenes.caption: Kavi is disintegrating
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Kavi's hand turning into digital light particles, his red hoodie sleeve fraying into binary.

scenes.text: The architect smiles as Kavi becomes code, bound forever to the logic of the recursive loop.
scenes.caption: Kavi becomes data
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi's face becoming transparent and pixelated, merging with the red digital patterns of the doorway.
